Layout report for Four Degrees of Doubt in the Ogham Corpus (build 2026-10-09)
page: A0 portrait (841 x 1189 mm)
base text size chosen by autofit: 29.0 pt (range 28-30)
header title size: 90 pt
theme: caa-uk (CAA United Kingdom), state ready
  colours from: CAA UK logo (CAAUK-Logo_fulltitle_bluewhite.png)  (licence Logo colour measured from the logo file; the logo itself belongs to CAA UK, check its usage terms before publishing it)
  typeface: Barlow
  contrast: 26 pairings checked, 1 below the recommended level, lowest 4.13 (card title, accent 'secondary')
body height: 1031 mm available, 1025 mm natural, slack 7 mm
note: autofit grew the body text to 29.0 pt because there was room. To keep it smaller and give figures the room instead, lower the cap (theme_overrides: typography: autofit: max_pt) or raise max_height_mm of the figures.

Blocks (why each one looks the way it does):
- hook: 358 mm wide, 105 mm natural, 133 mm drawn
    why: States the problem in two sentences: editions mark doubt precisely, graphs flatten it. The orange card is the poster's one warm colour, used for doubt.
- idea: 447 mm wide, 133 mm natural, 133 mm drawn
    why: Says in one paragraph and two bullets what the two open pipelines do with the same editions.
- ladder: 813 mm wide, 171 mm natural, 171 mm drawn
    why: The backbone of the poster: four stones from secure to doubtful, with the doubt each edition actually carries, counted in the transliteration edition. Photographs follow once the repositories are extended; dashed boxes hold their place.
- journey: 813 mm wide, 105 mm natural, 105 mm drawn
    why: The method as four stations. Reasoning is planned, not done: the AMT graphs hold no axioms yet, so the engine validates and exports but derives nothing.
- markup: 257 mm wide, 243 mm natural, 250 mm drawn
    why: Zooms into station 1: the markup signals and the certainty the rule gives each. Choice and cert are marked as to do because the converter does not read them yet.
- crosswalk: 283 mm wide, 239 mm natural, 250 mm drawn
    why: Zooms into station 2: a short mapping table, and the coordinate statuses that axis 1 hands over to axis 2.
- weigh: 257 mm wide, 216 mm natural, 250 mm drawn
    why: Zooms into station 3 with the repository's worked example, Gigha 1 (CIIC 506). To be replaced by Blackwaterfoot 1 once the repository holds it.
- limits: 362 mm wide, 153 mm natural, 178 mm drawn
    why: The honest block. Two limits that the four stones expose: one reading always weighs 1.0, and doubt that lives in prose is not in the markup.
- question: 217 mm wide, 178 mm natural, 178 mm drawn
    why: Closes with the question of the abstract and the two numbers behind it.
- links: 217 mm wide, 105 mm natural, 178 mm drawn
    why: Where the reader goes next: both pipelines, the engine and the editions.
- team: 117 mm wide, 121 mm natural, 154 mm drawn
    why: Puts a face to the one name in the header.
- supporters: 211 mm wide, 154 mm natural, 154 mm drawn
    why: Names funders, infrastructure and networks with their logos (draft: logo set of chnt31-fdox, to be confirmed, PRIMER D3).
- references: 469 mm wide, 132 mm natural, 154 mm drawn
    why: Cites the methods papers and the editions this poster builds on, taken from the author's DHd abstract.
